## One course story across the semester

Each box represents a meeting from the tentative Fall 2026 schedule. Boxes can become dedicated pages as notes, slides, activities, and resources are developed.

::: {.lecture-key aria-label="Lecture status key"}

### Interactive chapter courses

Chapters 9 and 10 form a two-part energy course. The highlighted boxes open the **complete, self-paced student lessons**, with central questions, Science, Issues, Solutions, takeaways, animated experiments, games and notebooks. The presentations **Chapter_9.pptx** and **Chapter_10.pptx** summarize each chapter for a 50-minute class. Each lesson includes a figure index and illustrations from its presentation.

[Open Chapter 9: Fossil Fuels and Nuclear Energy](guest-lecture-01-energy-systems/){.btn .btn-primary}

[Open Chapter 10: Renewable Energy](guest-lecture-02-renewable-transition/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

[Browse the chapter learning paths](../chapters/) · [Open the tentative course schedule](../weeks/)
